% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): plots in a scope count for the
% automatic limits (data, untransformed); with a scope shift a mark moved
% beyond the box is still drawn and extends the bounding box (AC5).
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}
\addplot coordinates {(0,1) (1,2)};
\begin{scope}[xshift=6mm]
  \addplot coordinates {(2,3) (3,5)};
\end{scope}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
